scope: Bluetooth on installed signed r6 against an independent owner-provided USB adapter; pairing removed afterwards. No HID, audio or resume pass.
peer: Plugable Bluetooth 4.0 USB adapter (Broadcom BCM20702A0) on the development host
phone: 6.18.59-r6 build 7; Qualcomm HCI v6 over btqcomsmd; WLAN associated on 5 GHz ch36 during the run

results.unpaired_l2ping: 10/10 (about 7 ms) after making the peer discoverable; 'Connection refused' while it was not discoverable (peer accept policy)
results.inquiry: host finds the phone in 1 s
results.phone_initiated_pairing: success on first attempt, bonded (SSP numeric comparison confirmed on both sides)
results.bonded_l2ping: 4 replies (11-44 ms), then reset by peer; consistent with the peer closing an idle profile-less link
results.traced_paging_to_phone: host page reaches the phone and is accepted (earlier run on this adapter)

harness_lessons: peer must be discoverable or the device known, or BlueZ rejects/never accepts unknown connections
confirmation must be answered on both sides for every pairing attempt
the earlier PC-adapter failures and WLAN-state correlation were harness/peer artifacts
open: HID and audio profiles (need a peripheral in pairing mode)
whether Iris rail state with WLAN off affects Bluetooth
